title: Personal OKR draft & weekly check-in — Olivia Park — 2026-03-06
content:
Status: DRAFT

Quick context:
I own a small initiative to reduce inference unit costs and 95th-percentile latency for the customer-facing conversational product (hosted API). This doc is a working draft of my OKRs for Q1-Q2 and the weekly check-in notes + short retrospective. Mostly notes to self + things to discuss with manager and SRE/serving-runtime leads.

OBJECTIVE 1 — Reduce production token cost (USD/token) while preserving quality
KR1.1 — Reduce avg cost-per-token for chat generation by 12% vs baseline (2026-01-01) -> current: -7%
KR1.2 — Roll out model quantization and validate no >1.5% drop in rouge/accuracy on eval set -> current: quantization A/B running on 10% traffic, initial rouge delta = -0.9%
KR1.3 — Implement cache prefixing for top 20% of routes -> prototype in staging (see notes)

OBJECTIVE 2 — Improve tail latency and reliability for the hosted API
KR2.1 — Reduce 95p latency for standard chat route from 320ms -> 250ms -> current: 285ms
KR2.2 — Add fallback policy for model variants so 99.9% of requests served within SLA during maintenance windows -> policy drafted, needs infra review
KR2.3 — Create observability dashboard for token-level cost + latency per model -> dashboard WIP (console route: /dash/olivia-token-latency)

WEEKLY PROGRESS (2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-06)
- Quantization A/B: ran 3 days of traffic, sampling 10% q8_128 model variant. Perf: -9% cost, latency +6ms median, 95p +18ms. Quality: rouge dev set -0.9% (within target). Next: expand to 25% if infra approves.
- Batcher improvements: landed PR to reduce small-batch penalty (github.com/redwood-inference/batcher/pull/58). Initial tests: throughput +4% at p50 latency unchanged. Need longer soak.
- Prefix cache prototype: staging demo working for routes with repeated preambles (search + system prompts). Found cache invalidation edge case when prompt includes timestamp. Created ticket JIRA-4321.
- Dashboard: added token-level metrics via existing trace hooks; still need product approval for retention window and roles.

BLOCKERS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Infra capacity: Dedicated infra team needs to OK increasing GPU pool for 25% quantization rollout during afternoon peak; raising risk of impacting other experiments. Who can help prioritize? (ask: Samira / Rahul)
- Eval automation: current eval harness is slow for multi-seed runs; need lightweight pass to validate quantization quality faster. Proposal: add a sampled-eval mode that runs 3 seeds on core prompt sets.
- Cache invalidation logic: need a small policy decision on which prompt tokens are considered stable (system+user intro) vs volatile (timestamps, uuids). Suggest: strip tokens matching iso8601/uuid regex before keying.

NEXT WEEK (high priority)
- Expand quantization A/B to 25% with infra guardrails and fallbacks (owner: me)
- Follow up with infra on temporary GPU burst window for experiment (owner: Samira, cc: infra lead)
- Finalize cache invalidation heuristics and add unit tests (owner: me + batcher team)
- Soak batcher PR in staging for 72h and collect p95/p99.
- Sync with product on dashboard retention & rollout plan.

RETROSPECTIVE NOTES (what worked / didn't)
- Worked: small, iterative experiments (10% -> 25%) make stakeholders comfortable and reduce blast radius. Having a quick staging demo accelerates buy-in.
- Didn't work: assumed eval harness would scale; it slowed iterations. Need to prioritize light-weight evals for early signals.

ACTION ITEMS (to capture in tickets)
- JIRA-4321: prefix cache invalidation policy + tests -> high
- JIRA-4332: sampled-eval mode for quantization validation -> med
- JIRA-4335: infra temp-GPU-burst request for 25% rollout -> high
- Follow-up PR: monitor/alert if quantized variant 95p latency exceeds baseline+50ms -> me

NOTES TO SELF / TL;DR
- Keep quantization rollout conservative; watch 95p closely.
- Prioritize smaller eval runs for speed — early signal beats long offline runs.
- Keep the dashboard simple: stakeholders care about cost per route and p95.

DISCUSSION TOPICS FOR 1:1 WITH MANAGER
- Risk tolerance for expanding quantization during peak (need decision on GO/NO-GO threshold)
- Support for getting short-term infra capacity for experiment window
- Headcount ask: do we spin up a 0.25 FTE SRE for two months to help with rollout?

REFERENCES / LINKS
- Batcher PR: github.com/redwood-inference/batcher/pull/58
- Eval ticket: JIRA-4332
- Cache invalidation ticket: JIRA-4321
- Dashboard draft: confluence.redwood.com/olivia/token-latency-dash (internal)

Random scratchpad / TODOs (short):
- draft email to infra leads (include cost calc + rollback plan)
- prepare small slide (2 slides) for product sync showing cost benefit -> 12% target vs current 7%
- add simple canary rule: if quality delta > 1.5% for 2 consecutive days -> auto-rollback
